query: SELECT strftime(date_trunc('month', date), '%Y-%m') AS month, count(DISTINCT tx_hash) AS txs FROM (SELECT date, tx_hash FROM (SELECT date, tx_hash, script_hash AS h FROM transaction_scripts WHERE date in <year window> UNION ALL SELECT date, tx_hash, owner_payment_credential AS h FROM address_utxo WHERE date >= DATE '2021-09-01' AND date < DATE '2022-01-01') WHERE h IN ('3e7530a023f5780a8fb800d23f9a338b76e5c4f2dd2edd19b29610fb', '6b3cb86f8aee9b5d754ba7aff3acea986297e833d52af0b00efe37c7', 'c48cbb3d5e57ed56e276bc45f99ab39abe94e6cd7ac39fb402da47ad', 'e319d8e6629ff7991c8ae4f8aec2e0f10463ebdf29b57d26d34914f6') UNION ALL SELECT date, tx_hash FROM address_utxo WHERE date >= DATE '2021-09-01' AND date < DATE '2022-01-01' AND policy_id IN ('c48cbb3d5e57ed56e276bc45f99ab39abe94e6cd7ac39fb402da47ad')) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
